management_steps.details: Children: Paracetamol, oral, 10-15 mg/kg/dose 6 hourly when required. Adults: Paracetamol, oral, 500 mg to 1 g, 4 to 6 hourly as required (to a maximum of 4 g in 24 hours). Maximum dose: 15 mg/kg/dose.
Refer to dosing table Chapter 23 for children.
